Spring Route.name: Spring Route
Spring Route.description: The user lays a connected route of scalp balls across a building's broken floors and walls. For the rest of the scene the user can rebound along it to reach trapped rooms, return with one person at a time and avoid gaps in the floor. Everyone else still sticks to the route, so rescuers need clear markers; placing it leaves the user's scalp painfully raw. Strain: severe.
